summary.name: LogNorm
summary.one_liner: LogNorm is a growth platform that combines SEO, GEO and AI visibility data into one ranked plan that AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and teams carry out.
keywords: what to fix first on my website
track if chatgpt mentions my brand
use_cases: Prioritizing which SEO and content tasks to do first
Having AI coding agents fix broken pages and SEO issues in a codebase
Tracking whether ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews cite your brand
Drafting and publishing SEO blog posts with agent help
Managing growth work across several client sites as an agency
Running a free baseline scan of a website's growth gaps
summary.what_it_does: LogNorm gathers data from six sources: a site audit, a GEO audit (AI crawler access, llms.txt, structured data), Google Search Console, keyword research, competitor analysis, and answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Each finding becomes a task called a move, which its decision engine ranks head to head with a stated reason. AI agents connect via MCP and take tasks from the plan, such as fixing issues in a repo and opening pull requests, or drafting posts with briefs. LogNorm re-checks fixes on the live site and measures shipped moves at 28 and 90 days using Search Console before-and-after data. A free growth scan scores a site without signup.
notable: Ranked growth plan that agents execute, with reasons for each ranking
Re-checks agent fixes on the live site and measures results at 28 and 90 days
Tracks AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews
Free growth scan and a 14-day Growth trial with 1,000 credits, no card needed
caveats: Paid plans beyond Free: Starter $99/month, Growth $149/month, Scale $299/month; plans differ in websites, seats, credits and tracked AI prompts
Free plan includes 1 website, 1 member and requires bringing your own AI keys
Google Search Console is the only data source named for search performance
